Claim 1 (Currently amended): A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, wherein said light emitting diodes are arranged in a non-uniform pattern.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open and includes a protective cover.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are arranged in a non-uniform pattern radially around the columnar body.

Claim 6 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are disposed in a non-uniform pattern between said diodes.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 1 further including a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes, wherein said optic element is configured to enhance light distribution.

Claim 4 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element includes a phosphor material that converts light emitted by said diodes.

Claim 14 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current, and further includes a dimming capability.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face, and each diode is independently controllable.

Claim 12 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 1 including a single optic element disposed between each adjacent fin overlapping said diode, wherein the optic element is designed to maximize light output.

Claim 16 (Currently amended): A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline, and further including a heat sink integrated into the design.
